clauses.heading: Scope
clauses.text: The Developer shall design, build and maintain the Client's loyalty mobile application in accordance with the Statement of Work.

clauses.heading: Fees
clauses.text: The Client shall pay the Developer's monthly invoices within fifteen (15) days of receipt.

clauses.heading: Ownership of work product
clauses.text: The Developer retains all intellectual property rights in the software, source code and documentation. The Client receives a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the software for the term of this Agreement.

clauses.heading: Limitation of liability
clauses.text: The Developer's total liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the three (3) months preceding the claim. Nothing in this Agreement limits the Client's liability.

clauses.heading: Confidentiality
clauses.text: The parties shall keep each other's confidential information confidential for one (1) year after termination.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This Agreement shall remain in force until 31 August 2027.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: The Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving one hundred and eighty (180) days' written notice. The Developer may terminate for convenience by giving thirty (30) days' written notice.

clauses.heading: Subcontractors
clauses.text: The Developer may engage subcontractors and offshore teams at its discretion without notifying the Client.

clauses.heading: Data protection
clauses.text: The Developer shall notify the Client of any personal data breach within thirty (30) days of becoming aware of it.

clauses.heading: Governing law
clauses.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan and disputes shall be resolved by the courts of Baku.
